verdicts.explanation: Section 2.2 attributes LaBi1.9Te0.1O4.05Cl at 0.02 S/cm and 702 °C to Yaguchi et al. (ref 33), so literature_cited is correct and the value and temperature match.
Section 2.2 gives LuBi1.9Te0.1O4.05Cl as a bulk conductivity of 0.022 S/cm at 492°C, attributed to Ueno et al. (ref 34); the bulk kind and literature_cited origin match.
Section 2.3 states that LaNb0.92W0.08O4.04 exhibits roughly 0.1 S/cm at 1000 °C, citing ref 59, so the material, value, temperature and origin are correct.
Section 2.3 gives La0.2Pb0.8WO4.1 at 0.042 S/cm and 800 °C with an activation energy of 0.59 eV for the high-temperature regime, citing ref 61.
Section 2.3 reports CeNbO4+δ at approximately 0.03 S/cm at 850 °C, cited to refs 35, 36 and 62, so literature_cited is correct.
Section 2.5 reports Ba3Ti0.9Mo1.1O8.1 with a total conductivity of 3.9×10-3 S/cm at 600 °C from Tawse et al. (ref 40), which matches the record's total kind and literature_cited origin.
Section 2.5 gives Ba3Nb0.9V0.1MoO8.5 a high bulk ionic conductivity of ~10-2 S/cm at 600 °C, citing ref 105; the record matches.
Section 2.5 attributes a bulk conductivity of 5.8×10-4 S/cm at 310 °C to Ba7Nb3.9Mo1.1O20.05 from Yashima et al. (ref 38), so the record is correct.
Section 2.5 reports Ba7Nb4−xCrxMoO20+x/2 at 1.6×10-3 S/cm and 508 °C from Sakuda et al. (ref 110), so the value, temperature and origin match.
Section 2.5 attributes 4×10-3 S/cm at 510 °C for Ba7Nb4MoO20 to Fop et al. (ref 109), matching the record.
Section 2.5 gives Ba7Ta3.7Mo1.3O20.15 a conductivity of 1.08×10-3 S/cm at 377°C from Murakami et al. (ref 111), matching the record.
Section 3.2 reports Rb5BiMo4O16 at 2.3×10−3 S/cm at 560 °C from Yasui et al. (ref 153), matching the record; the other reported value is correctly left out.
Section 2.11 reports donor-doped Ca2.7La0.3Fe2Ge3O12 at approximately 10−3 S/cm at 700 °C, citing ref 150, which matches the record.
Section 2.4 gives 3.39 × 10-2 S/cm at 800 °C for La9.5Si5.45Mg0.3Mo0.25O26+δ, citing ref 101; the Mg and Mo dopants match the composition.

Section 2.7 reports LaSr0.6Bi0.4Ga3O7.2 at approximately 1.62×10-2 S/cm at 800°C, citing ref 137; the tilde in the quote is not copied into the value field, which is acceptable.
